BEHIND THE FINISHED FRAMES

Ideas taking
shape.

Every finished space starts with a process. Here's a closer look at a master bedroom currently taking shape at Dwarrek.

SITE PROGRESS

PROJECT JOURNAL · MASTER BEDROOM

A considered space, taking shape.

A warm, layered master bedroom is underway, bringing together soft architectural curves, detailed joinery and a calm material palette.

01Cove Ceiling

Layered false ceiling with smooth cove detailing and softly rounded edges for a seamless finish.

02Wall Panelling

Custom wall panelling with carefully aligned lines and rounded transitions to add depth without visual clutter.

03Wallpaper Accent

Selected wallpaper detailing to bring texture, warmth and a refined focal point into the bedroom.

04TV Unit

Full HDM sheet panelling with a clean groove pattern, creating a crisp, integrated entertainment wall.

05Custom Storage

Built-in wardrobe and display niches planned for practical everyday storage with a cohesive finish.

06Finishing Details

Coordinated materials, neat junctions and considered lighting details to bring the entire room together.
